_comment: Writes an EXPANDED copy to data/jsb_schemas_expanded (never over data/jsb_schemas). Same seed, split, size limit and subset ORDER as the default import, so the original schemas should be a subset (verify with: python src/analyze_schema_pool.py --expanded-source jsb_schemas_expanded). Counts are 'take all eligible'. Needs network access to Hugging Face (small download, no model). The v2 import config itself is not in the repo; split/seed/subset order below are the importer defaults and UNVERIFIED.
